newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air passenger numbers up 3.3pct in Nov 96.
newsitem.headline: German air passenger numbers up 3.3pct in Nov 96.

text.p: German airline passenger numbers rose 3.3 percent to 8,453,357 in November 1996, figures from the German airports authority ADV showed.
The highest demand was for intercontinental flights with an 8.3 percent rise to 1.5 million passengers, the latest ADV monthly traffic report said.
Passenger numbers to and from European destinations rose 4.8 percent to 3.7 million, but domestic German air travel fell 0.8 percent to 3 million passengers.
January-November 1996, total German air passenger numbers rose 2.7 percent to 105,788,529 travellers, the report said.
Intercontinental travel rose 2 percent to 17.23 million passengers and European air travel increased 5.3 percent to 54.87 million over the first eleven months.
Domestic German air travel accounted for 31.78 million passengers, a fall of 0.9 percent, from January-November. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
